data_corpora.description: CollegeFootballData.com REST API. The opened API documentation says it retrieves college-football game, team, player, recruiting, ranking, and analytics data; the generated client/API documents expose a historical /lines endpoint plus game, season, and week parameters. This is an API source, not a static downloadable corpus; complete endpoint coverage and response size were not verified.

calibration_research.title: Beyond temperature scaling: Obtaining well-calibrated multiclass probabilities with Dirichlet calibration
calibration_research.implementable_method: Fit a multiclass Dirichlet calibration map on held-out predictions: log-transform the uncalibrated class probabilities, fit one regularized linear layer plus bias with a softmax output by held-out negative log likelihood, then freeze those coefficients for deterministic inference. This directly calibrates the three-way home/draw/away output.

calibration_research.title: Temporal Probability Calibration
calibration_research.implementable_method: For probabilities emitted at different forecast horizons or sequential information lengths, fit a separate calibration map for each discrete horizon and minimize held-out negative log likelihood; alternatively fit a fixed smooth temperature function of horizon and apply it to logits. Freeze the horizon-specific maps or temperature parameters before deployment.

calibration_research.title: More on verification of probability forecasts for football outcomes: score decompositions, reliability, and discrimination analyses
calibration_research.implementable_method: On a held-out chronological calibration set, fit one-vs-rest logistic calibration or isotonic (iso) regression for each home/draw/away probability, renormalize the three outputs, and freeze the maps. Evaluate with reliability diagrams, Brier/log scores, and score decomposition rather than accuracy alone.

calibration_research.title: Conformal prediction beyond exchangeability
calibration_research.implementable_method: For temporal drift, compute a nonconformity score on a chronological calibration window and use a fixed recency-weighted empirical quantile rather than an unweighted quantile; use that quantile to form prediction sets or score intervals around the frozen model output. Freeze the window, weights, and quantile rule for deterministic deployment.

calibration_research.title: Variable-Based Calibration for Machine Learning Classifiers
calibration_research.implementable_method: Choose a pregame variable of interest such as forecast horizon, favorite strength, conference, or weather bin; train a decision tree using only that variable on a calibration set, then fit beta calibration within each leaf (Dirichlet calibration for multiclass outputs). Freeze the tree and leaf calibrators and report both ordinary ECE and variable-based calibration error.
